resources.string: Tap NEW SCRIPT to write or paste your first one.
This removes it from your device. It cannot be undone.
All scripts and settings are removed and the sample script returns.

Welcome to CueScroll. Tap anywhere on the prompter to start or pause the scroll.

Drag with a finger to scrub to any spot. The amber line marks where you should be reading.

Use the speed and size controls at the bottom to match your pace. Volume up and volume down also change the speed, and most Bluetooth clickers will play or pause.

Turn on MIRROR when you shoot through a beam splitter glass so the reflection reads correctly.

Write your own scripts from the main list. They stay on your device, with no account and no internet.

That is the whole show. Good luck out there.
